purpose: A6 measurement-noise floor, three-run target tables, touched collective points and extra-pass costs; diagnostic only; three diagnostic A6 reruns on the scratch tables
memory_limit: RLIMIT_AS 30 GiB inside each script or ulimit -v 31457280 for the A6 reruns
source_commit_at_execution: 9fd97c1b for the noise floor and table builder (scripts then uncommitted, committed unchanged as c4a0244b); c4a0244b for the A6 reruns

commands.name: noise_floor
commands.command: env PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/tests/analysis PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 TMPDIR=/data/ycfeng/tmp timeout 120s /data/ycfeng/envs/frontier-py310/bin/python tests/analysis/v4_attention_noise_floor.py --reference /data/ycfeng/tmp/b13r_accept/after/rows.json --comparison /data/ycfeng/tmp/g2h_accept/rows_01/rows.json /data/ycfeng/tmp/g2h_accept/rows_04/rows.json --a6-result task_memory/task_2026-10-15_glm53_dsv4_vllm028_h800/h3o_operator_costs/a6_codex_20261101/result.json --output /data/ycfeng/tmp/glm53_dsv4/a6_noise_20261101/noise_floor.json

commands.name: three_run_tables
commands.command: env PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/tests/analysis PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 TMPDIR=/data/ycfeng/tmp timeout 120s /data/ycfeng/envs/frontier-py310/bin/python tests/analysis/v4_attention_multipass_table.py --published-table data/profiling/compute/h200/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash/attention_graph_replay_kernel_only.csv --reference /data/ycfeng/tmp/b13r_accept/after/rows.json --comparison /data/ycfeng/tmp/g2h_accept/rows_01/rows.json /data/ycfeng/tmp/g2h_accept/rows_04/rows.json --output-dir /data/ycfeng/tmp/glm53_dsv4/a6_multipass_20261101/tables
commands.note: The first attempt was piped through grep; its output and exit status were lost after it wrote one table. The partial directory was removed and the unchanged command rerun with output redirected to a log.

commands.name: a6_original_shared
commands.command: env PYTHONPATH=$PWD PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 WANDB_DISABLED=true VIDUR_DISABLE_WANDB=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 TMPDIR=/data/ycfeng/tmp/glm53_dsv4/a6_multipass_20261101/runs/original_shared FRONTIER_TMP_ROOT=/data/ycfeng/tmp/glm53_dsv4/a6_multipass_20261101/runs/original_shared bash -c "ulimit -v 31457280; timeout 7200 /data/ycfeng/envs/frontier-py310/bin/python -u tests/analysis/v4_attention_heldout.py --table /data/ycfeng/tmp/glm53_dsv4/a6_multipass_20261101/tables/original_shared/attention_graph_replay_kernel_only.csv --folds 5 --seed 1234 --scratch-dir /data/ycfeng/tmp/glm53_dsv4/a6_multipass_20261101/runs/original_shared/fold_caches --output-dir /data/ycfeng/tmp/glm53_dsv4/a6_multipass_20261101/runs/original_shared/out"
